name: telomerase reverse transcriptase

function.text: TERT encodes the catalytic reverse-transcriptase component of telomerase. Together with the TERC RNA template, it adds telomeric repeats to chromosome ends.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal dominant 2 (semidominant); dyskeratosis congenita, autosomal dominant 2 (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Liposarcoma; Paraganglioma; Chondrosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: TERT encodes the catalytic reverse-transcriptase component of telomerase. Together with the TERC RNA template, it adds telomeric repeats to chromosome ends.
